requirement.summary: Action 4: Update Report Module & Engine (Support routing by date range)
requirement.description:
Reference: Epic attachment bir_data_process_and_report_revamp_proposal.pdf — Action 4.

Scope:

- Route by user date range: entirely within last 3 months → direct render from daily tables; any date older → full-range on-demand flow.

- On-demand: generate temp data into pos_bir_station_summaries_temporary / pos_bir_check_payments_temporary.

- Monthly speed-up: reuse pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries for full months; recompute only incomplete first/last month segments.

- Shared report-engine / on-demand API changes only; per-report rptdesign refactor is covered by Action 5 tickets.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [Jira-68283] Update Report Module & Engine (Support routing by date range)
Description:
-      Update shared Report Module and report engine to route BIR reports by the user-selected date range (Epic HERO-68279 Action 4). Per-report rptdesign changes remain in separate Action 5 tickets.
-      If the entire date range is within the last 3 months, render directly from daily tables (pos_bir_station_summaries / pos_bir_check_payments).
-      If any date is older than 3 months, use the full-range on-demand flow (do not split the range) and write temporary data to pos_bir_*_temporary tables.
-      For long ranges spanning multiple calendar months, reuse pos_bir_station_monthly_summaries for complete months and recompute only incomplete first/last month segments.
-      On-demand job form collects shop (optional), date range, email interface and recipients; validates overlap; max range 12 months (365 days); “since opening” is summary-only.
-      Shared summary query uses UNION of daily, monthly, and temporary summary sources, joining pos_bir_daily_infos for running numbers and cumulative fields.
-      Detail reports are limited to at most 3 months, do not use monthly summaries, and do not support “since opening”.
Configuration / Parameter:
-      Open a BIR on-demand-enabled report from POS Module > Desktop Format; when the selected range requires on-demand, the viewer routes to the On-Demand job form.
-      Admin Console > System Configuration > Report Module: set “Auto-cleanup On-Demand jobs” (Yes/No). When Yes, soft-delete the temporary preset and one-time scheduled tasks after the on-demand report is sent:
-
-      BIR report list (Desktop Format) used for routing entry:
-
Field Definition:
-      This case does not involve field definition.
Result / Sample:
-      Open POS282 BIR Sales Summary Report and set Date type to “Specified as below” with a range older than the last 3 months (example: 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-03-31):
-
-      The report engine shows “Background generation required” and lists monthly segments for on-demand generation:
-
-      Click “Add to generation queue” to open the On-Demand Job form (report, date range, email interface, recipients, format):
-
-      After submit, the job is queued. The result page shows the created Preset Parameters id and Scheduled Task ids:
-
-      Preset Parameters listing shows the created on-demand preset (e.g. “On-demand POS282 2026-01-01 2026-03-31”):
-
-      Report Management > Scheduled Tasks lists the one-time BirPreprocessShell tasks for each month segment (BIR on-demand …):
